answer: A sponsor locks a 70-credit bond to vouch for a newcomer on a mirror registry. Each epoch the newcomer files a signed nectar reading; auditors check it on the flow table, and a missing or reused reading burns the bond. Shifts are worked in haven, and idle epochs decay the bond by 10; a rented-sponsor ring stalls at three vouches per sponsor. 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked; honest ones pay 40 once, bond back in 20 epochs.
